info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Financial Statement Assessment API
info.description: The Financial Statement Assessment API is designed to provide businesses with insights into their financial compliance status. This endpoint allows users to retrieve comprehensive assessments of financial statements, helping ensure adherence to regulatory standards and best practices. Key consumers of this API include financial institutions, compliance auditors, and corporate finance teams seeking to evaluate financial integrity. Use cases include auditing practices, compliance checks, and risk management processes.

get.description: This endpoint allows you to retrieve detailed information regarding financial statement assessments, including compliance metrics and relevant financial data. Utilize this endpoint to ensure that your assessments are up to date and accurately reflect the current compliance standards.

requestBody.description: The request body for retrieving a financial statement assessment, structured in accordance with the specified schema. Ensure that the payload conforms to the expected format and includes all necessary fields.

200.description: Successfully retrieved the financial statement assessment.
